violations.description: General employee practices. — --Food employee observed without proper hair restraint. Food employee with long hair was found without hair restraint. Long hair should be restrained.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Equipment that dispenses liquid/food/ice in unpackaged form was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. Beverage dispenser found with debris buildup. These should be cleaned more thoroughly and maintained clean.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned adequately. Multiple prep tables were found in need of thorough cleaning in and out of units. Inside of hot hold units found with food debris. Donut case found with debris around bottom of doors. Box fans found with dirt build up. These items should be cleaned and maintained clean.

Storage of cleaned equipment and utensils. — --Clean equipment/utensil was not stored in the proper location to protect from contamination. Utensils found stored in dirty drawers. Clean equipment should be stored in a clean location.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored in a proper location to be protected from contamination. Portion cups and lids stored under hot hold cases were stored in a dirty bin. Single use items should be stored in a clean location.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Floor in walk-in freezer and throughout kitchen and dry storage found in need of thorough cleaning under equipment. Floors should be maintained clean.

Preventing contamination by employees. — --Employee observed using same pair of single-use gloves for more than one task. Gloves were on the hands of food employee as she used machine to print tickets, but gloves were not changed before continuing food preparation. Gloves should be changed when switching tasks.
